# @arki/schema

> Standard Schema helpers for every validator: the spec types, `parse`/`parseAsync` with typed returned failures, issue paths, and a JSON Schema bridge. It is not a validator; bring Zod, Valibot, ArkType or your own.

## Import paths

<!-- llms:start -->
- `@arki/schema`: Standard Schema for every validator: the spec types, `parse` and `parseAsync`, the throwing `is`/`assert`/`ensure`, issue helpers, and a JSON Schema bridge. `AssertError`, `SCHEMA_ERROR_CODES`, `SchemaRunError`, `assert`, `ensure`, `formatIssues`, `hasJsonSchema`, `is`, `isStandardSchema`, `parse`, `parseAsync`, `pathOf`; and 11 more.
<!-- llms:end -->

## Rules that bite
- Sync `parse` returns `AsyncSchema` on an async schema. Use `parseAsync`.
- `InvalidInput` means bad data. `ValidatorDefect` means a schema defect; never map it to HTTP 400. Canonical definitions live in `@arki/failure`.
- `withJsonSchema` answers only the `draft-2020-12` target.
- Import the spec types from `@arki/schema`, never from `@standard-schema/spec`. A lint rule enforces it.
